name: Elena Rostova
psychographics: Values work-life balance highly; believes convenience services should free up time for hobbies, not just more work emails.
current_solutions: HelloFresh for dinner kits; DoorDash for occasional date night takeout; local laundromat pickup service on weekends.
frustration: The laundromat pickup service closed early on a Saturday at 2 PM, two hours before her shift ended, forcing her to wash clothes by hand in the apartment sink after a 10-hour workday.
decision_style: Reads user reviews on forums for weeks; values peer recommendations and reliability over the lowest price point.
voice: Blunt and practical; speaks in short, clipped sentences; frequently uses slang like "frickin'" or "kinda" when expressing frustration with services.
